تنتخبون (form VIII)
# تَنْتَخِبُونَ (tantaḵibūna) /tan.ta.xi.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَخَبَ (intaḵaba)
# تُنْتَخَبُونَ (tuntaḵabūna) /tun.ta.xa.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَخَبَ (intaḵaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
